UAV Antenna Array and Beamforming Co-Design

xhail/uav-array-codesign-rl

Design a 2x2 drone antenna array and write a beamforming and link controller that keeps the link up through flights and jamming.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • evaluating frontier agents on physics simulators

Reward

How it is scored
Hidden tests
Signal
Pass or fail

Reward is 1 only if all 6 tests pass, including hidden missions and a fresh-run check of the agent's summary.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

T=tasks/engineering-sciences/electrical-engineering/uav-array-codesign
harbor trials start -p $T -a oracle

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download xhail/uav-array-codesign-rl --repo-type dataset --local-dir uav-array-codesign-rl

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/xhail/uav-array-codesign-rl --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Docker.

Evidence

The oracle solution passes 6/6 tests; Beam, DeepSeek and baseline runs failed (4/6, 3/6, 1/6).

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
